pages.text: There are a few machines in Mariculture that run off of Redstone Flux. This is a power system created by Team COFH, makers of Thermal Expansion. As of right now Mariculture introduces one new way to produce Redstone Flux. This is by the creation of a water turbine.
pages.title: Power Generation

pages.text: To create this, you will need to create a rotor, a sluice, iron construction blocks and a generator.
